title: Every nonempty family in {-∞,0,1,...,∞} has a minimum
statement: Every nonempty subset $S$ of the totally ordered set $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$ has a least element; equivalently, for every nonempty index set $I$ and every map $f:I\to\{-\infty,0,1,\ldots,\infty\}$, the infimum $\inf_{i\in I}f(i)$ equals $f(i_0)$ for some $i_0\in I$.

source.place: Definition 5.10.1, tag 0055 (definition-Krull), item (4): the formula $\dim_x(X)=\min\{\dim(U)\}$ takes a minimum, which exists by this statement
